name: Rotary-operation qualifier
summary: This qualifier identifies an operating mechanism actuated by rotation.
description: This qualifier identifies an operating mechanism actuated by rotation. Rotation can operate a stepped selector, a maintained switch or a continuously adjusted element. The operating mark identifies the mechanical action without deciding which of those electrical functions is present.
Where discrete positions matter, provide the position names and a contact table. A rotary mark alone cannot distinguish local/remote selection from a voltage-measurement selector.
readingNotes: Identify the operating positions and associated contact table separately.
Rotary actuation does not imply continuous adjustment or a particular number of positions.
drawingChecklist: Identify the associated device, circuit or diagram boundary.
Identify the operating positions and associated contact table separately.
Cross-reference the equipment data, terminal mapping or operating-state legend needed to interpret the form.
distinction: Rotary actuation does not imply continuous adjustment or a particular number of positions.
